source_claim: GOODSMILE RACING's first-party Hatsune Miku GT Project page says the team's trademark is a machine with a Hatsune Miku Racing Ver. design. Good Smile's official product pages identify the exact 2013, 2013 Sepang, 2014, 2015, 2023 and 2025 Racing Miku designs as the official character/mascot of the Hatsune Miku GT Project; these are the six exact campaign variants and establish their relation to the canonical Hatsune Miku Character.
notes: Checked official products: https://www.goodsmile.info/en/product/4153/Racing%2BMiku%2B2013%2Bver.html ; https://www.goodsmile.info/en/product/7599/Nendoroid%2BRacing%2BMiku%2B2013%2BSepang%2BVer.html ; https://www.goodsmile.info/en/product/4552/ ; https://www.goodsmile.info/en/product/5414/Racing%2BMiku%2B2015%2BVer.html ; https://www.goodsmile.info/en/product/15238/figma%2BRacing%2BMiku%2B2023%2Bver.html ; https://www.goodsmile.com/en/product/1137000/Racing%2BMiku%2B2025%2BVer. The 2013 project page identifies Hatsune Miku Racing Ver.; each named product explicitly identifies its Racing Miku variant and the Hatsune Miku GT Project.
